br_as1.title: Assault
br_as1.description: +2 Attack Damage, +0.005 Movement Speed. Point man doctrine. First in, last out, always aggressive.

br_as2a.title: Battering Ram
br_as2a.description: +3 Attack Damage, +0.1 Knockback Resistance. You ARE the breaching tool. Shoulder-charge through doors AND infected.

br_as2b.title: Flash Entry
br_as2b.description: +1 Attack Damage, +0.3 Attack Speed, +0.01 Movement Speed. Disorient, enter, eliminate. Speed and aggression in one package.

br_as3aa.title: Juggernaut Rush
br_as3aa.description: +4 Attack Damage, +0.15 Knockback Resistance. An unstoppable charge. The horde parts before you or gets crushed beneath.

br_as3ab.title: Siege Hammer
br_as3ab.description: +4 Attack Damage, +3 Armor Toughness. Each swing carries the weight of a battering ram backed by impenetrable armor.

br_as3ba.title: Blitz Striker
br_as3ba.description: +0.5 Attack Speed, +0.01 Movement Speed. Lightning-fast room clearing. In the door, everything dead, out the window.

br_as3bb.title: Total Assault
br_as3bb.description: +3 Attack Damage, +0.3 Attack Speed, +0.1 Knockback Resistance. The complete operator. Speed, power, immovability.

br_bp1.title: Blast Padding
br_bp1.description: +4 Max Health. Layered Kevlar and ceramic plates. Explosions that kill others merely inconvenience you.

br_bp2a.title: Blast Vest
br_bp2a.description: +6 Max Health. Military-grade EOD protection. You've walked into blast zones that would liquify normal humans.

br_bp2b.title: Reactive Plates
br_bp2b.description: +3 Max Health, +0.15 Knockback Resistance. Explosive reactive armor  -  detonates outward on impact, nullifying force.

br_bp3aa.title: Walking Fortress
br_bp3aa.description: +8 Max Health. A mobile bunker. The infected break themselves against you like waves against a seawall.

br_bp3ab.title: Shock Dampener
br_bp3ab.description: +5 Max Health, +0.1 Knockback Resistance. Internal gel padding absorbs all kinetic energy. Nothing reaches your organs.

br_bp3ba.title: Explosive Resistance
br_bp3ba.description: +0.25 Knockback Resistance. Stand in the blast radius and laugh. Shockwaves are just gentle breezes to you.

br_bp3bb.title: Bomb Proof
br_bp3bb.description: +4 Max Health, +0.2 Knockback Resistance. They can detonate everything they have. You'll still be standing.

br_cap1.title: Siege Engine
br_cap1.description: +2 Attack Damage, +4 Max Health. You are a weapon of war made flesh. Buildings and bodies fall alike.

br_cap2a.title: Juggernaut
br_cap2a.description: +4 Attack Damage, +6 Max Health, +0.15 Knockback Resistance. The ultimate heavy. Nothing stops you, nothing survives you.

br_cap2b.title: Wrecking Ball
br_cap2b.description: +5 Attack Damage, +4 Max Health, +0.01 Movement Speed. Demolition incarnate. Charge through, destroy everything, keep moving.

br_cap3aa.title: God of War
br_cap3aa.description: +6 Attack Damage, +8 Max Health. Invincible. Unstoppable. The apex predator of the apocalypse battlefield.

br_cap3ab.title: Absolute Defense
br_cap3ab.description: +6 Max Health, +0.3 Knockback Resistance, +4 Armor Toughness. The perfect shield. Nothing penetrates, nothing moves, nothing kills.

br_cap3ba.title: Extinction Hammer
br_cap3ba.description: +6 Attack Damage, +0.4 Attack Speed. Destruction at impossible speed. Each swing ends a life, each second clears a room.

br_cap3bb.title: Nuclear Option
br_cap3bb.description: +5 Attack Damage, +6 Max Health, +0.2 Knockback Resistance, +0.01 Movement Speed. The final answer. Nothing survives. Nothing.

br_dm1.title: Demolition
br_dm1.description: +2 Attack Damage. You know where structures  -  and bodies  -  break apart. Apply force correctly.

br_dm2a.title: Breach & Clear
br_dm2a.description: +3 Attack Damage. First through the door, first to kill. Your strikes carry the force of shaped charges.

br_dm2b.title: Concussive Force
br_dm2b.description: +2 Attack Damage, +0.15 Knockback Resistance. Hits that stun AND stand firm. The perfect offensive-defensive combo.

br_dm3aa.title: Payload
br_dm3aa.description: +4 Attack Damage. Each swing carries the payload of a breaching charge. Bone shatters like drywall.

br_dm3ab.title: Shockwave
br_dm3ab.description: +3 Attack Damage, +0.1 Knockback Resistance. Every hit sends tremors through the horde. Impact damage amplified.

br_dm3ba.title: Wrecking Force
br_dm3ba.description: +0.2 Knockback Resistance. Nothing displaces you mid-swing. Your attacks land with full commitment every time.

br_dm3bb.title: Seismic Strike
br_dm3bb.description: +3 Attack Damage, +3 Armor Toughness. Hits so hard the ground shakes. Your own armor reinforces from the shockwave.

br_eod1.title: EOD Suit
br_eod1.description: +4 Max Health, +2 Armor Toughness. Explosive Ordnance Disposal gear. Built to survive what should kill you.

br_eod2a.title: Blast Proof
br_eod2a.description: +6 Max Health, +2 Armor Toughness. Nothing detonates near you that you can't survive. Tested by fire  -  literally.

br_eod2b.title: Quick Defuse
br_eod2b.description: +2 Max Health, +0.01 Movement Speed, +0.2 Attack Speed. Fast hands for wires, fast feet for escape. Multi-purpose operator.

br_eod3aa.title: Indestructible
br_eod3aa.description: +8 Max Health, +3 Armor Toughness. The ultimate protection. Walk through ground zero and emerge unscathed.

br_eod3ab.title: Armored Endurance
br_eod3ab.description: +5 Max Health, +4 Armor Toughness. Endurance AND protection. You outlast every threat through sheer defensive superiority.

br_eod3ba.title: Agile Heavy
br_eod3ba.description: +0.015 Movement Speed, +0.3 Attack Speed. Heavy doesn't mean slow. You're a freight train that throws punches.

br_eod3bb.title: Full Kit
br_eod3bb.description: +4 Max Health, +3 Armor Toughness, +0.1 Knockback Resistance. Every slot filled. Every angle covered. Maximum operational readiness.

br_ft1.title: Fortification
br_ft1.description: +3 Max Health, +2 Armor Toughness. You build defenses  -  including your own body. Layered protection.

br_ft2a.title: Pillbox
br_ft2a.description: +4 Max Health, +0.15 Knockback Resistance. Bunker mentality applied to biology. You ARE the defensive position.

br_ft2b.title: Trench Runner
br_ft2b.description: +2 Max Health, +0.01 Movement Speed, +0.1 Knockback Resistance. Navigate the chaos. Move through explosions like they're background noise.

br_ft3aa.title: Reinforced Bunker
br_ft3aa.description: +6 Max Health, +0.2 Knockback Resistance. Multi-layered defense system. You outlast sieges that level buildings.

br_ft3ab.title: Combat Engineer
br_ft3ab.description: +4 Max Health, +3 Armor Toughness. Build it tough, BE tough. Engineering principles applied to survival.

br_ft3ba.title: Blitz Sprint
br_ft3ba.description: +0.015 Movement Speed. Fast breach, fast clear. Speed kills  -  especially when you're armored like a main battle tank.

br_ft3bb.title: Mobile Bastion
br_ft3bb.description: +3 Max Health, +0.01 Movement Speed, +0.15 Knockback Resistance. A moving fortress. Unbreakable, unstoppable, inescapable.

br_hl1.title: Heavy Lifter
br_hl1.description: +0.01 Movement Speed. Carry a hundred pounds of gear at a jog. Your legs are industrial pistons.

br_hl2a.title: Load Bearer
br_hl2a.description: +0.015 Movement Speed. Trained to sprint in full kit. Fifty pounds of breaching gear doesn't slow you.

br_hl2b.title: Sprint Carry
br_hl2b.description: +0.008 Movement Speed, +3 Max Health. Full combat load at full speed. Your conditioning is superhuman.

br_hl3aa.title: Power March
br_hl3aa.description: +0.02 Movement Speed. Unstoppable forward momentum. You advance through anything  -  walls, hordes, or hellfire.

br_hl3ab.title: Armored Sprint
br_hl3ab.description: +0.012 Movement Speed, +3 Armor Toughness. Full plate, full speed. An armored train on two legs.

br_hl3ba.title: Battle Endurance
br_hl3ba.description: +5 Max Health. Run all day in heavy armor. Your cardiovascular system is a military-grade engine.

br_hl3bb.title: Unstoppable Advance
br_hl3bb.description: +0.01 Movement Speed, +4 Max Health, +0.1 Knockback Resistance. Nothing halts your forward progress. Not walls. Not hordes. Nothing.

br_mn1.title: Munitions Expert
br_mn1.description: +2 Attack Damage. You understand ordnance. Translate that knowledge to melee  -  strike weak points.

br_mn2a.title: High Explosive
br_mn2a.description: +3 Attack Damage, +1 Luck. Maximum yield from minimum material. Efficient destruction incarnate.

br_mn2b.title: Fragmentation
br_mn2b.description: +2 Attack Damage, +0.2 Attack Speed. Each strike sends bone shrapnel into nearby targets. Collateral damage is the point.

br_mn3aa.title: Thermobaric
br_mn3aa.description: +5 Attack Damage. Strikes that create vacuum zones. The overpressure alone damages nearby infected.

br_mn3ab.title: Shaped Charge
br_mn3ab.description: +3 Attack Damage, +2 Armor Toughness. Directed force. All energy channeled into the point of impact.

br_mn3ba.title: Rapid Detonation
br_mn3ba.description: +0.4 Attack Speed. Plant, trigger, repeat. Your combat rhythm is the tempo of controlled explosions.

br_mn3bb.title: Ordnance Mastery
br_mn3bb.description: +3 Attack Damage, +0.3 Attack Speed. Complete weapons expertise. Every strike is a precisely timed detonation.

br_rs1.title: Hard Target
br_rs1.description: +0.2 Knockback Resistance. Low center of gravity, wide stance. The horde pushes and you don't budge.

br_rs2a.title: Immovable
br_rs2a.description: +0.25 Knockback Resistance. Planted like a tank trap. Multiple infected charging simultaneously can't move you an inch.

br_rs2b.title: Counterblast
br_rs2b.description: +0.15 Knockback Resistance, +2 Attack Damage. Absorb their charge, return it tenfold. Every push triggers a counterstrike.

br_rs3aa.title: Absolute Anchor
br_rs3aa.description: +0.35 Knockback Resistance. Even Calamities can't move you. You are the immovable object.

br_rs3ab.title: Fortress Foundation
br_rs3ab.description: +0.2 Knockback Resistance, +4 Max Health. The base others build upon. Rooted, vital, eternal.

br_rs3ba.title: Counter Charge
br_rs3ba.description: +3 Attack Damage. They charge you  -  you hit them harder. Momentum redirected into their faces.

br_rs3bb.title: Tectonic Stance
br_rs3bb.description: +0.2 Knockback Resistance, +2 Attack Damage, +2 Armor Toughness. An earthquake that hits back. Geological force personified.

br_vt1.title: Reinforced Body
br_vt1.description: +4 Max Health. Steel-plated existence. Your body is as reinforced as the doors you breach.

br_vt2a.title: Iron Frame
br_vt2a.description: +6 Max Health. Internal skeleton reinforced with trauma plates. You ARE the armor.

br_vt2b.title: Tough & Fast
br_vt2b.description: +3 Max Health, +0.01 Movement Speed. Heavy armor, light feet. You breach AND pursue.

br_vt3aa.title: Titanium Core
br_vt3aa.description: +8 Max Health. Bone density beyond measurement. The infected break their claws on your ribcage.

br_vt3ab.title: Combat Chassis
br_vt3ab.description: +4 Max Health, +0.012 Movement Speed. Engineered for breach-and-clear ops. Fast entry, heavy impact.

br_vt3ba.title: Heavy Armor
br_vt3ba.description: +4 Armor Toughness. Military-grade plating over every vital. Attacks glance off harmlessly.

br_vt3bb.title: Living Tank
br_vt3bb.description: +5 Max Health, +3 Armor Toughness. Part man, part armored vehicle. The ultimate frontline presence.
